forum.best_answer_content:

forum.content_text:
An issue has been identified in which STM32CubeMX displays a download error pop-up during data updates.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/a36c007e-71a1-46ef-ba92-16c3509fab7b.png)

This issue**does not prevent** STM32CubeMX from working properly. To continue:

Click **OK** twice.

After these steps, STM32CubeMX can operate normally.

If this pop-up affects your workflow, disable the Auto-Refresh feature:

In **Help** → **Connection and Updates**, select **No Auto- Refresh at Application start**.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/5cab9b3e-6366-4841-a6d5-8e85e5e006fa.png)

Please note that if Auto-Refresh is disabled, STM32CubeMX uses the local cube-finder-db.zip file and does not retrieve updates automatically.

If needed, manually update the data:

**Help** → **Refresh Data**

A fix is in progress in a future version.
